source: NOAA NCEI Global Significant Earthquake Database (2150 BC–present) merged with USGS ComCat M>=6 (1900–present)
notes: h/mi -1 = unknown (UTC). mag: preferred magnitude (estimated from intensity when flags&4). dep km (-1 unknown). I0 = epicentral intensity (reported MMI, or predicted by Allen et al. 2012 when larger/missing). level = user scale 0-5 of I0. flags: 1 NCEI, 2 USGS, 4 magnitude estimated, 8 size assumed (no magnitude/intensity: I0=7), 16 tsunami reported, 32 NCEI intensity XII without magnitude or any recorded impact discarded as implausible. place = index into places[] (shared with tsunamis.json). ts = NCEI tsunami event id. Years are astronomical (0 = 1 BC, -4999 = 5000 BC). Month/day 0 = unknown. Dates are kept as recorded by the source (Julian before 1582-10-15, as is conventional in the catalogues); the game calendar is proleptic Gregorian.
